lead_raw_text:
The trigonal phase Ti3Ni9C6 (reduced formula TiNi3C2) crystallizes in space group R-3 (No. 148), with 18 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies carbon centers with four geometric neighbors (1 Ni, 3 Ti), nickel centers with two carbon neighbors, and titanium centers with ten neighbors (6 C, 4 Ni). The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 18 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner and edge sharing between Ni-centered 2-vertex polyhedra, and edge sharing between C-centered 4-vertex and Ti-centered 10-vertex polyhedra.
